fromDate.description: Inclusive start of the requested analytics period.

toDate.description: Inclusive end of the requested analytics period.

language.description: Language used to scope Search Analytics.

currency.description: Optional currency used to scope Search Analytics.

channel.description: Optional channel used to scope Search Analytics.

subChannel.description: Optional subchannel. It is ignored when channel is omitted.

classifications.description: Optional case-sensitive Classification Key and Value filters. Blank Keys or Values are ignored. Use filter-option discovery for available selections.

term.description: Case-insensitive text filter for search terms.

pagination.description: Optional page selection. Defaults to page 1 with 50 terms.

description: Date range, filters, and pagination for a side-effect-free Search Analytics term query. The endpoint determines the ranking type.
